description: P7A (RESEARCH-EXECUTION-PRICING-PARITY-01) cross-language golden vector. Both mqk_research.ml.execution_pricing.conservative_fill_price_micros (Python) and core-rs/crates/mqk-backtest/src/engine.rs's BacktestEngine::conservative_fill_price (Rust, exercised end-to-end via BacktestEngine::run) must resolve every case below to the exact same fill_price_micros. Prices are decimal dollars; *_micros fields are the canonical integer form (round(price * 1_000_000)). Do not edit expected_fill_price_micros without re-deriving it by hand from the formula documented in engine.rs's conservative_fill_price doc comment -- these values are the independent proof, not derived by calling either implementation.
formula: base = high if side==buy else low; bar_spread_bps = (high-low)*10000 // close; vol_component = bar_spread_bps*volatility_mult_bps // 10000; effective_slippage_bps = slippage_bps + vol_component; adjustment = base*effective_slippage_bps // 10000; buy => base+adjustment; sell => base-adjustment
